name: MsoPresetTextEffectShape
description: Specifies shape of WordArt text. You can see a preview of each text effect shape by selecting WordArt Shape on the WordArt toolbar.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeMixed
constants.description: Not used.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapePlainText
constants.description: No shape applied.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeStop
constants.description: Text follows the shape of a stop sign.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeTriangleUp
constants.description: Text slants down, then up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeTriangleDown
constants.description: Text slants up, then down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeChevronUp
constants.description: Text slants down to its center point and then slants up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeChevronDown
constants.description: Text slants up to its center point and then slants down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeRingInside
constants.description: Text appears to be written inside a 3D ring.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeRingOutside
constants.description: Text appears to be written outside a 3D ring.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchUpCurve
constants.description: Text is an arch that curves up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchDownCurve
constants.description: Text is an arch that curves down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCircleCurve
constants.description: Text follows a circle, reading clockwise.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeButtonCurve
constants.description: Text is curved around a center "button."

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchUpPour
constants.description: Text is a 3D arch that curves up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeArchDownPour
constants.description: Text is a 3D arch that curves down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCirclePour
constants.description: Text has a 3D effect and follows a circle, reading clockwise.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeButtonPour
constants.description: Text is seen in 3D, curved around a center "button."

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCurveUp
constants.description: Text curves down and to the right as font size increases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCurveDown
constants.description: Text curves down and to the right as font size decreases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCanUp
constants.description: Text is stretched to fill the height of the shape, with only a slight curve up.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCanDown
constants.description: Text is stretched to fill the height of the shape, with only a slight curve down.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeWave1
constants.description: Text follows a wave up, then down and up again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeWave2
constants.description: Text follows a wave down, then up and down again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDoubleWave1
constants.description: Text follows a line that curves up, then down, then up and down again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDoubleWave2
constants.description: Text follows a line that curves down, then up, then down and up again.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflate
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter is on the same straight line.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflate
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflateBottom
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter follows an arch that curves downward.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateBottom
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size, while keeping the top of the text along the same curve.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeInflateTop
constants.description: Font size of text increases to its center point, then decreases. Center point of each letter follows an arch that curves upward.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateTop
constants.description: Font size decreases to the text's midpoint, then increases to the starting size, while keeping the bottom of the text along the same curve.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateInflate
constants.description: Font size increases to the text's midpoint, then decreases to the starting size.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeDeflateInflateDeflate
constants.description: Font size decreases, increases, and decreases again across the text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeRight
constants.description: Right side of text appears to be closer to the viewer than left side.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeLeft
constants.description: Left side of text appears to be closer to the viewer than right side.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeUp
constants.description: Bottom of text appears to be closer to the viewer than top.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeFadeDown
constants.description: Top of the text appears to be closer to the viewer than bottom of the text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeSlantUp
constants.description: Text slants up and to the right.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeSlantDown
constants.description: Text slants down and to the right.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCascadeUp
constants.description: Text slants down and to the right as font size increases.

constants.name: msoTextEffectShapeCascadeDown
constants.description: Text slants up and to the right as font size decreases.
